top_signals.title: A rate rise is the right decision, but stop blaming Iran
top_signals.summary: The Bank of England’s unanimous decision to raise interest rates to four per cent reflects serious concerns over persistent inflation, not just external shocks. The government most now address root cost issues rather than blaming external factors like the war in Iran, says Emmanuel Igwe The war in Iran has been central to the Bank [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Taiwan to Deploy Market Stabilization Fund After Stock Rout
top_signals.summary: Taiwan authorized its National Financial Stabilization Fund to step in to support the island’s stock market after a selloff whipsawed the tech bellwether.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Binance’s $6.3B hack leaves questions over hot wallet safeguards
top_signals.summary: Experts say blockchain records show repeated wallet drains but cannot establish Binance’s internal signing controls or transaction limits.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
